title: Chrome in orbit
description: A chrome filament opens, threads through itself, and transforms.
prompt: Create a 16-second wordless motion film with a single chrome filament as the hero. Choreograph it from an open strand into a loop, through a threading transformation, and into a satisfying final form. Use polished reflections, dark studio lighting, deliberate camera movement, and an original electronic score. No titles or supporting copy.

title: A lighthouse in space
description: An original miniature science-fiction film built from generated footage.
prompt: Make a tiny sci-fi film about a lighthouse that wakes up in space.

title: One interview. One great clip.
description: A 44-second Jensen Huang interview highlight with vertical framing and burned captions.
prompt: Turn this interview recording into one postable vertical clip, 30 to 60 seconds, with burned captions. Pick the strongest self-contained moment yourself. Preserve the speaker’s meaning, remove dead space, keep the subject comfortably framed, and make the captions easy to read on a phone.

title: Hash maps, explained
description: Watch two keys collide, then see how a hash map resolves the collision.
prompt: Make me a 45 second narrated explainer on how a hash map handles collisions.

title: A study in copper
description: A sculptural copper surface pleats, curls, and unfolds.
prompt: Create a 16-second wordless motion film starring one copper folding sculpture. Animate the material through precise pleats, a curl, and a full unfolding. Keep the sculpture centered, with warm directional light that reveals the metallic surface and a restrained camera move. Add an original score. No titles or supporting copy.

title: REN: Redline
description: An original anime character, choreographed fights, music, and impact sounds.
prompt: Make one 20–25 second edit of an original badass anime character fighting a bunch of different villains. Invent the character, atmosphere and a little plot. Keep the character consistent and the actions flowing logically, with nothing out of place. Hone in on the moves and the sounds of punches, overlapping the music. Include some shots showing his aura and some fast mini-clips playing side by side on specific beats. Make it feel like a great anime fight edit. Use video generation together with Video Use's existing editing tools.

title: Every finish lands
description: An Ilia Topuria sports edit built around finishing sequences and music timing.
prompt: Create a 40–45 second sports highlight edit from my footage. Build around the strongest finishing moments, with the best sequence landing on the biggest musical beat. Use smooth speed ramps, a small zoom punch, a brief amber color shift, and a short flash, all arriving on the same impact frame. Use real footage and a vocal track I provide. Deliver 1080 × 1920 with uncropped widescreen footage in the middle, black space above and below, and no burned-in text.

title: Inside a jet engine
description: Real engine footage meets a clear animated cutaway.
prompt: Make a 40 second explainer about how a jet engine works. Use real footage where it helps and diagrams where it does not.

title: Follow the blue
description: Blue sparks become capsules, ribbons, rings, and a pinwheel.
prompt: Create a 15-second wordless motion film with luminous blue shapes. Develop one continuous transformation from sparks to capsules, then ribbons, a ring, and a pinwheel. Give each state a clear readable moment and make each transition flow naturally into the next. Use a dark studio background and an original score. No UI, labels, or supporting text.

title: Nightclub takeover
description: A generated cinematic character story with a dramatic entrance and payoff.
prompt: Invent a ruthless nightclub boss and make a cinematic edit of the night she takes her club back. I want danger, expensive-looking shots, a huge entrance, and a finish that feels iconic. Give it a tense crime-film atmosphere and a slowed, reverberant music mood. Keep it under 30 seconds.

title: From keynote to your feed
description: A self-contained 58-second keynote exchange, reframed for vertical video.
prompt: Turn this keynote recording into one postable vertical clip, 30 to 60 seconds, with burned captions. Pick the strongest self-contained moment yourself. Preserve the speaker’s meaning, remove dead space, keep the subject comfortably framed, and make the captions easy to read on a phone.

title: Why caching feels instant
description: A visual walkthrough of cache hits, request latency, and database load.
prompt: Explain how adding a cache changes request latency and database load.

title: Aperture, assembled
description: An eight-blade optical mechanism pulls apart and closes into place.
prompt: Create an eight-second, wordless 3D study of an optical aperture. Assemble eight metallic blades, open and close the iris, then separate the parts in a controlled exploded view. Use brushed metal, soft studio lighting, a dark background, and a slow deliberate camera. Keep every transformation mechanically clear.

title: Gravity rescue
description: An original superhero rescue, generated and edited into a cinematic short.
prompt: Invent a superhero who can bend gravity and make an incredible rescue film around a train falling into a city. Create cinematic shots with a clear escalation, believable character continuity, music-synced action, and a satisfying rescue payoff. Keep it under 30 seconds.

title: Feel the crowd
description: A Peso Pluma performance showcase assembled from live footage.
prompt: Make a 40–45 second performance showcase from my concert footage. Mix close-ups with huge crowd reactions, and build toward the moment the whole room sings together. Use the track I provide and sync each visual anchor to the music. Add smooth speed ramps, subtle zoom punches, and a consistent warm color pulse on the biggest beats. Keep the original performance footage uncropped in a widescreen strip inside a vertical 1080 × 1920 frame. No text or graphics.

title: From DNA to protein
description: An animated journey from genetic information to a folded protein.
prompt: Explain how cells turn DNA into proteins.
